Resolution criteria:
- "St. Louis Cardinals": Wins if the St. Louis Cardinals have a higher official final score than the Cincinnati Reds at the conclusion of the August 20, 2026 MLB game played at Great American Ball Park.
- "Cincinnati Reds": Wins if the Cincinnati Reds have a higher official final score than the St. Louis Cardinals at the conclusion of the August 20, 2026 MLB game played at Great American Ball Park.

Clarifications:
- The official final score is determined after all innings are complete, including any extra innings played. If the game is postponed and not completed before the market's settlement time, the market resolves based on the completed makeup game's result; if the game is cancelled with no makeup, neither outcome applies.
